title: Predicted extraction shaft beneath the Red Pyramid

tellings.quote: there should be an extraction shaft coming from below the final synthesis chamber of the red pyramid.

plain: There should be an extraction shaft running down from below the last inner room of the Red Pyramid, an ancient pyramid at Dahshur in Egypt, according to a researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who says an alien told him the true purpose of the pyramids. Drumm calls that room the "final synthesis chamber" and makes the prediction from his own theory of what the pyramids were for. If such a shaft were found, it would support his idea that the pyramids worked as a kind of production plant.
